title: Dr. Piero V.E. Terni

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 24747
7433
Date 14 9 39

SHANGHAI TIMES.

SEP 10 1939

Kidnappers
Were After
Dr. P. Terni

Italian Visitor Had Been
Seized By Mistake
On Friday Night

Investigation conducted by authorities late on Friday night, following the report of the kidnapping of Dr. Nevio Fanceschi, Italian visitor to Shanghai, after he had stepped out of St. Anne Building on Rue du Consulat on Friday evening, revealed that the kidnappers were apparently after Dr. Piero V. E. Terni, well-known local Italian attorney with offices on Yuen Ming Yuen Road.

Dr. Terni was offered protection both by the French Police and the Italian Consular authorities yesterday, but refused these, stating that he could take care of himself.

It is not surprising that the kidnappers who whisked away Dr. Fanceschi mistook him for Dr. Terni, as the two men are about the same height and build and both were dressed in a similar manner on Friday evening. Dr. Fanceschi had paid a visit to Dr. Terni at the latter's apartment and was leaving him when he was grabbed by armed Chinese, pushed into a car and driven away, later to be released on Avenue du Roi Albert after his identity was discovered.

Authorities are continuing investigations into the kidnapping, while Dr. Terni could not advance any reason why anyone should want to kidnap him.

（批：D C Crimi
Information）

《字林西报》

1939年9月10日

绑匪
原本意图绑架
P. Terni 博士

一名意大利访客于周五晚
被误抓

当局于周五深夜展开调查，此前有报告称，意大利访沪人士 Nevio Fanceschi 博士于周五傍晚在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）圣安妮大楼（St. Anne Building）外遭到绑架。调查显示，绑匪的目标显然是本地知名意大利律师 Piero V. E. Terni 博士，其事务所位于圆明园路。

昨日，法国警方和意大利领事当局均向 Terni 博士提供保护，但被他拒绝，他表示能够自我保护。

绑匪错将 Fanceschi 博士当作 Terni 博士掳走，这并不令人意外，因为两人身高体型相仿，且周五当晚着装相似。Fanceschi 博士此前曾前往 Terni 博士的寓所拜访，离开时遭到持枪华人袭击，被推入汽车并驾车带走。后来，在其身份被发现后，他在阿尔贝王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）获释。

当局正继续对绑架案进行调查，而 Terni 博士无法提出任何理由解释为何有人想要绑架他。

情报）

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.
SEP 9 1939

Italian Visitor Kidnaped,
Released After Three Hours

Baffled French police late last night were ready to abandon as an unsolved mystery the first foreign kidnaping, or rather attempted kidnaping, case which has occurred in Shanghai for years.
Near-victim of the kidnapers, according to the meager information in the hands of the French police themselves was one Signor Francesci, who arrived in Shanghai about a week ago for a short visit.
Although local Italian authorities gave the French police every co-operation they could in the unusual circumstances, the central character in the drama refused to speak. Despite all the efforts of the French police, Signor Francesci steadfastly remained silent, and added not one word to what the Italian authorities were able to pass on to the Concession minions of the law.
Signor Francesci, according to the information which was relayed to the French police, was held up by a gang of three armed Chinese as he left St. Anne Building in Rue du Consulat at about 7 last night. He was unceremoniously bundled in a waiting motor-car, gagged and blindfolded and had his hands bound.
After the car had traveled for about twenty minutes, he was taken into a foreign-style house, and was there asked if he was Italian. Answering in the affirmative, he was asked his name and particulars of his past. After hearing his replies, the apparent leader of the gang apologized and said they had made a mistake.
Once again the unfortunate visitor was blindfolded, gagged and bound and taken into the motor-car. He saw the dim light of night again at the corner of Avenue du Roi Albert and Route Paul Henri, and greatly shaken by his experience, immediately obeyed his orders to march straight ahead without looking back, on pain of instant death.
Eventually Signor Francesci made his way to an Italian restaurant opposite the Auditorium, and there, among his compatriots, related his story, which later reached the French police through the Italian authorities.
The Concession police were of the opinion that there had quite evidently been some plan to kidnap an Italian citizen, but for some unforeseen reason, the plan had failed, and the visitor had been an unwitting factor in the failure.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》
1939年9月9日

意大利访客遭绑架，
三小时后获释

昨晚深夜，困惑不已的法国警方准备将这起多年来发生在上海的首起外国人绑架案（或者更确切地说是未遂绑架案）作为一桩未解之谜搁置。
根据法国警方掌握的有限信息，这起绑架案的近乎受害者是一位 Francesci 先生，他约于一周前抵达上海进行短期访问。
尽管当地意大利当局在这种不寻常的情况下给予了法国警方一切可能的合作，但这出戏剧的中心人物却拒绝开口。尽管法国警方竭尽全力，Francesci 先生始终坚守沉默，对于意大利当局能够转达给租界执法人员的消息，他未补充一字。
据转达给法国警方的信息，Francesci 先生昨晚约7点离开领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）的圣安妮大楼时，遭到三名持枪华人的拦截。他被粗暴地塞进一辆等候的汽车，嘴被堵住，眼被蒙住，双手被捆绑。
汽车行驶了约二十分钟后，他被带进一所西式房屋，在那里有人问他是否是意大利人。他给予肯定回答后，又被问及姓名及过往经历。听到他的回答后，这伙人明显的头目道歉并称他们搞错了。
这名不幸的访客再次被蒙住双眼、堵住嘴巴并捆绑起来，随后被带入汽车。他在阿尔贝王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）和保罗·亨利路（Route Paul Henri）的拐角处再次看到了昏暗的夜色，因这段经历受到极大惊吓，他立即服从命令，径直向前走去，不得回头，否则即刻处死。
最终，Francesci 先生走到了大礼堂对面的一家意大利餐馆，在那里，他在同胞中间讲述了自己的遭遇，该故事随后通过意大利当局传到了法国警方耳中。
租界警方认为，显然存在某种绑架意大利公民的计划，但由于某些不可预见的原因，计划失败了，而这位访客在无意中导致了这一失败。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES.
SEP 3 1929

Wrong Man
Taken By
Bandits

Mr. Francesci Forced
To Car And Taken
For Questioning

A band of Chinese kidnapped a visiting Italian here by mistake, last night, but on discovering their mistake released the man without harming him. They had kept him blindfolded the whole time.

The victim was a Mr. Francesci, 30-years-of-age, who has only been in Shanghai about one week. When walking out of the Ste. Anne Building, at 25 Rue de Consulat, at 9 o'clock last night three Chinese rushed at him, with pistols, and forced him into a waiting motor car.

The car immediately started off. The two men in the back seat bound his hand; and tied a handkerchief over his eyes. They took him to foreign-style house where he was ordered by the Chinese in broken English, to answer a series of questions which the Italian could hardly understand.

They asked him his nationality, his business, his residence, his friends and many other questions, which the victim answered to the best of his ability. The bandits soon discovered that something was wrong and after further questioning and some discussion between themselves, arrived at the conclusion they had the wrong man.

Victim Released

They decided to release him. He was taken back into the motor car and driven to Rue Albert and Route Paul Henry where he was released. He was instructed not to look back at the car.

Mr. Francesci obeyed these instructions and then ran to the Sevilla Restaurant at 316-18 Avenue du Roi. Albert, opposite the Auditorium. He told of his capture and the proprietor informed the French Police.

The man was not injured in any way, and was released at 10.30 p.m. The police now have a double task on their hands, attempting to learn who the kidnappers were and who the real person they want may be.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》
1929年9月3日

绑匪
抓错
对象

Francesci 先生被强行带上车
带去审问

昨晚，一伙华人误绑了一名来访的意大利人，但在发现错误后，未加伤害便将其释放。在此期间，他们一直蒙着他的眼睛。

受害者是 Francesci 先生，30岁，抵沪仅约一周。昨晚9点，当他走出领事馆路25号圣安妮大楼（Ste. Anne Building）时，三名华人持枪冲向他，并将他强行塞进一辆等候的汽车。

汽车随即启动。后座的两名男子绑住他的双手，并用一块手帕蒙住他的眼睛。他们将他带到一所西式房屋，那里的华人用蹩脚的英语命令他回答一系列问题，这位意大利人几乎听不懂这些问题。

他们询问了他的国籍、职业、住址、朋友以及许多其他问题，受害者尽其所能作了回答。绑匪很快发现情况不对，经过进一步盘问和他们内部的一些讨论后，得出结论：他们抓错了人。

受害者获释

他们决定释放他。他被带回汽车，并被载至阿尔贝路（Rue Albert）和保罗·亨利路（Route Paul Henry），在那里被释放。他被指令不要回头看那辆车。

Francesci 先生遵从了这些指令，然后跑到大礼堂对面、阿尔贝王大道316-18号的塞维利亚餐馆（Sevilla Restaurant）。他讲述了自己被俘的经过，店主随即通知了法国警方。

该男子未受任何伤害，于晚上10:30获释。警方现在面临双重任务，既要查明绑匪是谁，又要弄清他们真正想要的人是谁。

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police.
CID Case No. 89786
September 8, 1939.

Subject: Supposed kidnapping of a foreigner.

At 9.30 p.m. September 8, the Chief of the Criminal Investigation Department was informed that a foreigner had been kidnapped by Chinese on Rue Montauban; that the foreigner had been released and that he could be found at the restaurant Sevilla on Avenue du Roi Albert.

Inspector Henri and Sergeant Clerissi proceeded immediately to the place to start an investigation. The foreigner concerned was Mr. Nevio Franceschi, an Italian lawyer, residing at No. 5 Kelmscot Garden, Avenue du Roi Albert, Telephone 71862. This gentleman has been in Shanghai only since July 9, 1938 coming, it appears, from Italian East Africa.

According to Mr. Franceschi, the kidnapping took place in the following manner:-

At about 6.20 p.m. Mr. Franceschi paid a call on his friend Mr. Piero V. E. Terni, lawyer, residing at No. 25 Saint Anne Building, Rue du Consulat where he also met Mr. Albini, another lawyer. He left them soon afterwards, saying: "I am going to take a taxi on Rue Montauban; you will join me at dinner at the Italian Club on Rue Maresca." Upon leaving his friends, he heard a Chinese say to him, "You want a car." Mr. Franceschi, who was in a hurry, replied in the affirmative. The Chinese showed him a car in front of the building and without any hesitation Mr. Franceschi entered the vehicle.

(It is to be noted that Mr. Franceschi claims that the taxi was waiting on the north side at the top of Rue du Consulat, the front of the car facing west. This seems improbable because none of our policemen would have permitted parking in this manner especially at this place.)
page_data.zh:
法国公董局警务处
刑事侦缉处案件编号：89786
1939年9月8日

主题：疑似外国人被绑架案。

9月8日晚9:30，刑事侦缉处处长获悉，一名外国人在蒙塔班路（Rue Montauban）被华人绑架；该外国人已被释放，可在阿尔贝王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）的塞维利亚餐馆找到。

亨利（Henri）巡官和克莱里西（Clerissi）警士立即前往该地开始调查。涉案外国人是 Nevio Franceschi 先生，一名意大利律师，居住在阿尔贝王大道凯尔姆斯科特花园（Kelmscot Garden）5号，电话71862。这位先生自1938年7月9日起才在上海，似乎是从意属东非而来。

据 Franceschi 先生称，绑架经过如下：

下午约6:20，Franceschi 先生拜访了他的朋友、律师 Piero V. E. Terni 先生，后者居住在领事馆路圣安妮大楼25号，他在那里还遇到了另一位律师 Albini 先生。不久后他离开他们，说道：“我要去蒙塔班路叫一辆出租车；你们到马尔斯卡路（Rue Maresca）的意大利俱乐部与我共进晚餐。”离开朋友后，他听到一名华人对他说：“你要车吗？”急于赶路的 Franceschi 先生予以肯定回答。那名华人向他展示了楼前的一辆汽车，Franceschi 先生毫不犹豫地进入了该车。

（值得注意的是，Franceschi 先生声称出租车停在领事馆路顶端北侧，车头朝西。这似乎不太可能，因为我们的警察绝不会允许在此地以这种方式停车。）

page_data.en:
-2-

As soon as the door of the car was closed,
a Chinese seated near the chauffeur suddenly turned around
and placing a revolver against Mr. Franceschi's stomach,
said, "Don't move." The car then started. Mr. Franceschi
was bound and his eyes blindfolded. The car was in motion
for about 20 minutes but he could not say what route it took.
The men then led him into a house where the bandage was
removed from his eyes. He found himself in a sort of grand
salon well laid out and guarded by two Chinese: one in a
grey gown and the other in a black long gown. These two men
were each armed with a Mauser pistol.
After waiting for about 20 minutes, a Chinese
neatly dressed in European clothing, entered and after making
an examination of Mr. Franceschi, said to him: "I am very
sorry. We have made a mistake. It was not you we wanted."
The Chinese asked Mr. Franceschi where he lived
and the latter replied, "Roi Albert." Mr. Franceschi was
then quickly blindfolded and taken to the corner of Avenue
du Roi Albert and Rue Paul Henry. When he was alighting
from the car, some one said to him at the point of pistols,
"Continue on your way without looking behind."
Mr. Franceschi said that he believed that the
car which took him there was a black one, whilst the taxi
that he had engaged on Rue du Consulat was of chestnut
colour, but he was not quite sure.
At II p.m. we approached Mr. Terni at his home
No. 25 Rue du Consulat. He declared that he could not
understand why this should have happened to his friend, Mr.
Franceschi. Mr. Terni does not think that Mr. Franceschi
had been mistaken for himself for he (Mr. Terni) has been
going out every night and returns very late at night,
sometimes even at three o'clock in the morning and he had
never noticed anything abnormal around him. Mr. Terni added
that he never had anything to do with Chinese and that he
had never taken any part in dubious affairs.
page_data.zh:
-2-

车门一关上，
坐在司机旁边的一名华人突然转过身，
将左轮手枪顶在 Franceschi 先生的腹部，
说：“别动。”汽车随即启动。Franceschi 先生
被捆绑起来，双眼被蒙住。汽车行驶了
约20分钟，但他无法说明行驶路线。
随后那些人将他带进一所房子，解开了
蒙在他眼睛上的绷带。他发现自己身处一个
布置精良的大客厅，由两名华人看守：一人身穿
灰色长袍，另一人身穿黑色长袍。这两人
各持一把毛瑟手枪。
等了约20分钟后，一名穿着
整洁欧式服装的华人走进来，在检查了
Franceschi 先生后，对他说：“非常抱歉。我们搞错了。我们要找的不是你。”
那名华人问 Franceschi 先生住在哪里，
后者回答：“阿尔贝王（Roi Albert）。”Franceschi 先生
随即再次被迅速蒙住双眼，并被带到
阿尔贝王大道和保罗·亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）的拐角处。当他下车时，
有人在手枪的威胁下对他说：
“继续往前走，不要回头。”
Franceschi 先生说，他认为带他去那里的
汽车是黑色的，而他在领事馆路叫的
出租车是栗色的，但他不是很确定。
晚上11点，我们到他家中拜访了 Terni 先生，
地址为领事馆路25号。他宣称无法理解
这种事为何会发生在他的朋友 Franceschi 先生身上。Terni 先生不认为 Franceschi 先生是被误认作他自己，因为他（Terni 先生）每晚都外出，深夜才归，
有时甚至到凌晨三点，而他从未注意到周围有任何异常。Terni 先生补充说，他从未与华人有过任何往来，也从未参与过任何可疑事务。

page_data.en:
-3-

Tonkinese Policeman No. 149 who was on duty in
front of the Chancery, declared that he did not see any taxi
parked at the place indicated by Mr. Franceschi, especially
in the manner that he had declared.

Chinese Policeman No. 133 declared that at about
5.30 p.m. he noticed a taxi parked in front of the French
Consulate, that this taxi was under tow and that soon
afterwards the taxi was towed into the garage. This was
found to be correct.

An investigation made by detective No. 225 at the
Ford, Johnson, Silver, Taylor, Edward, Kia and Tong Sing
garages had no result.

We note that Mr. Franceschi bears no resemblance
whatever to Mr. Terni.

The Director of the Criminal Investigation
Department also heard Mr. Franceschi's statement.

Henry,
Inspector.
page_data.zh:
-3-

在领事馆门前执勤的安南籍巡捕第149号声明，他没有看到任何出租车停在 Franceschi 先生指出的地点，尤其是以他所描述的方式停放。

华捕第133号声明，下午约5:30，他注意到一辆出租车停在法国领事馆前，该出租车正在被拖曳，不久后该出租车被拖入车库。经查证属实。

侦探第225号对福特（Ford）、约翰逊（Johnson）、银星（Silver）、泰勒（Taylor）、爱德华（Edward）、起亚（Kia）和同生（Tong Sing）车行进行的调查没有结果。

我们注意到，Franceschi 先生与 Terni 先生毫无相似之处。

刑事侦缉处处长也听取了 Franceschi 先生的陈述。

亨利，
巡官。

法国公董局警务处
刑事侦缉处案件编号：89786
1939年9月8日

主题：疑似外国人被绑架案。

9月8日晚9:30，刑事侦缉处处长获悉，一名外国人在蒙塔班路（Rue Montauban）被华人绑架；该外国人已被释放，可在阿尔贝王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）的塞维利亚餐馆找到。

哈姆里（Hamri）巡官和乌莱里西（Ulerissi）警士立即前往该地开始调查。涉案外国人是 Nevio Franceschi 先生，一名意大利律师，居住在阿尔贝王大道凯尔姆斯科特花园（Kelmscot Garden）5号，电话71862。这位先生自1938年7月9日起才在上海，似乎是从意属东非而来。

据 Franceschi 先生称，绑架经过如下：

下午约6:20，Franceschi 先生拜访了他的朋友、律师 Piero V. E. Terni 先生，后者居住在领事馆路圣安妮大楼25号，他在那里还遇到了另一位律师 Albini 先生。不久后他离开他们，说道：“我要去蒙塔班路叫一辆出租车；你们到马尔斯卡路（Rue Maresca）的意大利俱乐部与我共进晚餐。”离开朋友后，他听到一名华人对他说：“你要车吗？”急于赶路的 Franceschi 先生予以肯定回答。那名华人向他展示了楼前的一辆汽车，Franceschi 先生毫不犹豫地进入了该车。

（值得注意的是，Franceschi 先生声称出租车停在领事馆路顶端北侧，车头朝西。这似乎不太可能，因为我们的警察绝不会允许在此地以这种方式停车。）

page_data.en:
-2-

As soon as the door of the car was closed,
a Chinese seated near the chauffeur suddenly turned around
and placing a revolver against Mr. Franceschi's stomach,
said, "Don't move." The car then started. Mr. Franceschi
was bound and his eyes blindfolded. The car was in motion
for about 20 minutes but he could not say what route it took.
The men then led him into a house where the bandage was
removed from his eyes. He found himself in a sort of grand
salon well laid out and guarded by two Chinese: one in a
grey gown and the other in a black long gown. These two men
were each armed with a Mauser pistol.

After waiting for about 20 minutes, a Chinese
neatly dressed in European clothing, entered and after making
an examination of Mr. Franceschi, said to him: "I am very
sorry. We have made a mistake. It was not you we wanted."

The Chinese asked Mr. Franceschi where he lived
and the latter replied, "Roi Albert." Mr. Franceschi was
then quickly blindfolded and taken to the corner of Avenue
du Roi Albert and Rue Paul Henry. When he was alighting
from the car, some one said to him at the point of pistols,
"Continue on your way without looking behind."

Mr. Franceschi said that he believed that the
car which took him there was a black one, whilst the taxi
that he had engaged on Rue du Consulat was of chestnut
colour, but he was not quite sure.

At II p.m. we approached Mr. Terni at his home
No. 25 Rue du Consulat. He declared that he could not
understand why this should have happened to his friend, Mr.
Franceschi. Mr. Terni does not think that Mr. Franceschi
had been mistaken for himself for he ( Mr. Terni) has been
going out every night and returns very late at night,
sometimes even at three o'clock in the morning and he had
never noticed anything abnormal around him. Mr. Terni added
that he never had anything to do with Chinese and that he
had never taken any part in dubious affairs.
page_data.zh:
-2-

车门刚一关上，坐在司机旁边的一名中国人突然转过身，将一把左轮手枪顶在弗朗切斯基（Franceschi）先生的腹部，说道：“别动。”随后汽车启动。弗朗切斯基先生被捆绑起来，双眼被蒙住。汽车行驶了大约20分钟，但他无法说明行驶路线。随后，那些人将他带进一所房子，解开了他眼上的绷带。他发现自己身处一个布置考究的大客厅里，由两名中国人看守：一人身穿灰色长袍，另一人身穿黑色长袍。这两人各持一支毛瑟手枪。

等待了大约20分钟后，一名穿着整洁欧式服装的中国人走了进来，在审视了弗朗切斯基先生后，对他说：“非常抱歉。我们搞错了。我们要找的不是你。”

该中国人询问弗朗切斯基先生的住址，后者回答：“阿尔伯特王路（Roi Albert）。”随后，弗朗切斯基先生很快再次被蒙上双眼，并被带到阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）与保罗·亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）的拐角处。当他下车时，有人用枪指着他说道：“继续走，不要回头看。”

弗朗切斯基先生说，他认为送他去那里的汽车是黑色的，而他在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）雇用的出租车是栗色的，但他不太确定。

晚上11点，我们在领事馆路25号特里尼（Terni）先生家中拜访了他。他表示无法理解为什么他的朋友弗朗切斯基先生会遭遇此事。特里尼先生不认为弗朗切斯基先生是被误当作他自己，因为他（特里尼先生）每晚都外出，深夜才回家，有时甚至到凌晨三点，且从未注意到周围有任何异常情况。特里尼先生还补充说，他从未与中国人有过任何瓜葛，也从未参与过任何可疑事务。

page_data.en:
-3-

Tonkinese Policeman No. 149 who was on duty in
front of the Chancery, declared that he did not see any taxi
parked at the place indicated by Mr. Franceschi, especially
in the manner that he had declared.

Chinese Policeman No. 133 declared that at about
5.30 p.m. he noticed a taxi parked in front of the French
Consulate, that this taxi was under tow and that soon
afterwards the taxi was towed into the garage. This was
found to be correct.

An investigation made by detective No. 225 at the
Ford, Johnson, Silver, Taylor, Edward, Kia and Tong Sing
garages had no result.

We note that Mr. Franceschi bears no resemblance
whatever to Mr. Terni.

The Director of the Criminal Investigation
Department also heard Mr. Franceschi's statement.

Henry,
Inspector.
page_data.zh:
-3-

在公署门前执勤的东京籍巡捕第149号声明，他没有看到任何出租车停在弗朗切斯基先生所指的位置，特别是按照他所描述的方式停放。

华捕第133号声明，大约在下午5点30分，他注意到一辆出租车停在法国领事馆前，该出租车处于被拖曳状态，不久之后该车被拖入车库。经核实，情况属实。

侦探第225号对福特（Ford）、约翰逊（Johnson）、西尔弗（Silver）、泰勒（Taylor）、爱德华（Edward）、起亚（Kia）和同兴（Tong Sing）车库进行的调查未获结果。

我们注意到，弗朗切斯基先生与特里尼先生毫无相似之处。

刑事调查处处长也听取了弗朗切斯基先生的陈述。

亨利，
督察。

Affaire N° 89786
OBJET
Prétendu enlèvement
d'un Européen.
Agent en Charge
Inspecteur HENRY.

（批：Mr. Division
Transmise
Urgent
Au Sous）
Changhai le 8 Septembre 1939.

RAPPORT

Le 8 Septembre, à 21 heures 30, Monsieur le
Sous-Directeur, Chef de la Sûreté a été informé qu'un
étranger avait été enlevé rue Montauban par des chinois,
que cet étranger avait été relâché et qu'il se trouvait
présentement au restaurant "SEVILLA" Avenue du Roi
Albert.

L'Inspecteur HENRI et le SergentChef CLERISSI
se sont rendus aussitôt sur les lieux pour enquêter. Il
s'agissait de Mr.NEVIO FRANCESCHI, Avocat, de nationali-
té Italienne, demeurant au N°5 Kelmscot Garden, avenue
du Roi Albert (Téléphone 71862). Ce monsieur n'est à
Shanghai que depuis le 9 Juillet 1938, venant, paraît-il
de l'Afrique Orientale Italienne.

D'après la déclaration de Mr.FRANCESCHI, l'en-
lèvement se serait passé comme suit :

Vers 18 heures 20 Mr.FRANCESCHI est allé rendre
visite à son camarade Maitre PIERO V.E.TERNI, domicilié
au N°25 "Saint Anne Building" rue du Consulat où il a
également rencontré Maitre ALBINI. Il les quitta peu
après en disant : "Je vais prendre un taxi rue Montaubar
vous me rejoindrez pour dîner au Club Italien de la rue
Maresca". En sortant de chez ses amis (25 Consulat),
un chinois lui cria : "You want a car". Mr.FRANCESCHI,
qui était pressé, répondit affirmativement. Le chinois
lui montra un taxi en face de la maison, sans hésiter
Mr.FRANCESCHI monta dans la voiture ( il est à noter
que Mr.FRANCESCHI prétend que le taxi attendait déjà
...
page_data.zh:
刑事科
案件编号 89786
事由
涉嫌绑架一名欧洲人。
负责警员
亨利督察。

（批注：致处长
转呈
紧急
致副主管）
上海，1939年9月8日。

报告

9月8日21时30分，警务处副处长兼保安科长获悉，一名外国人曾在蒙塔班路（rue Montauban）被中国人绑架，该外国人已被释放，目前位于阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）的“塞维利亚（SEVILLA）”餐厅。

亨利督察和警长克里西（Clerissi）立即前往现场进行调查。当事人为内维奥·弗朗切斯基（NEVIO FRANCESCHI）先生，律师，意大利国籍，居住于阿尔伯特王路凯尔姆斯科特花园（Kelmscot Garden）5号（电话71862）。这位先生据称来自意属东非，于1938年7月9日才抵达上海。

根据弗朗切斯基先生的陈述，绑架过程如下：

约18时20分，弗朗切斯基先生前去拜访其同事皮耶罗·V.E.特里尼（PIERO V.E. TERNI）律师，后者居住在领事馆路“圣安妮大楼（Saint Anne Building）”25号，他在那里还遇到了阿尔比尼（ALBINI）律师。不久后他离开朋友家，说道：“我要去蒙塔班路坐出租车，你们到马雷斯卡路（rue Maresca）的意大利俱乐部与我共进晚餐。”当他走出朋友家（领事馆路25号）时，一名中国人对他喊道：“你要车吗？”弗朗切斯基先生因赶时间，肯定地回答了。该中国人向他指了指马路对面的一辆出租车，弗朗切斯基先生毫不犹豫地上了车（值得注意的是，弗朗切斯基先生声称那辆出租车已经在等待……

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Nord à hauteur de la Rue du Consulat. L'avant tourné
vers l'ouest. Ceci semble invraisemblable car aucun
de nos agents n'aurait permis un stationnement dans ce
sens surtout à cet endroit).

Dès que la portière fut refermée, un chinois
assis près du chauffeur se retourna brusquement et
cria "Dont Move" et lui braqua un revolver sur le ven-
tre. La voiture partit et Mr.FRANCESCHI fut ligoté et
eut les yeux bandés. La voiture aurait roulé une
vingtaine de minutes et Mr.FRANCESCHI ne peut dire le
trajet parcouru. Les ravisseurs le firent entrer dans
une maison et lui débandèrent les yeux. Il se trouvait
dans un espèce de grand salon très propre et était gar-
dé par deux chinois en longue robe. L'une grise et l'au-
tre noire. Ces deux hommes étaient armés chacun d'un
pistolet genre "Mauser". Après environ trente minutes
d'attente, un chinois élégamment vêtu à l'européenne,
est entré et il a examiné Mr.FRANCESCHI et lui a dit :
"I am very sorry, we have made a mistake, it was not
you we wanted ".

Le chinois a demandé à Mr.FRANCESCHI où il
habitait. Ce dernier a répondu : "Roi Albert". Aussitôt
Mr.FRANCESCHI fut emmené les yeux bandés et reconduit
jusqu'à hauteur de Paul Henry, Roi Albert. A la descen-
te de l'auto on lui a dit sous menace des pistolets :
"Continuez votre route sans regarder en arrière". Mr.
Franceschi dit qu'il croit que la voiture qui l'a ramené
était de couleur noire, tandis que le taxi qu'il a pris
rue du Consulat était de couleur marron, mais il n'en
est pas très certain.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

北侧，与领事馆路平行。车头朝西。这似乎不可信，因为我们的任何警员都不会允许车辆以这种方向停放，尤其是在该地段）。

车门刚一关上，坐在司机旁边的一名中国人突然转过身，喊道“别动（Dont Move）”，并用一把左轮手枪顶住他的腹部。汽车随即启动，弗朗切斯基先生被捆绑并蒙住双眼。汽车行驶了约二十分钟，弗朗切斯基先生无法说明行驶路线。绑匪将他带进一所房子，解开了他眼上的绷带。他发现自己身处一个非常整洁的大客厅里，由两名身穿长袍的中国人看守。一人穿灰色长袍，另一人穿黑色长袍。这两人各持一支“毛瑟”式手枪。等待了大约三十分钟后，一名穿着优雅欧式服装的中国人走了进来，审视了弗朗切斯基先生，并对他说：“非常抱歉，我们搞错了，我们要找的不是你。”

该中国人询问弗朗切斯基先生住在哪里。后者回答：“阿尔伯特王路（Roi Albert）。”弗朗切斯基先生随即被蒙上双眼带走，并被送回至保罗·亨利路（Paul Henry）与阿尔伯特王路（Roi Albert）附近。下车时，有人在手枪的威胁下对他说：“继续走，不要回头看。”弗朗切斯基先生说，他认为送他回来的汽车是黑色的，而他在领事馆路乘坐的出租车是棕色的，但他对此不太确定。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

A 23 heures, nous avons approché Mr.TERNI à
son domicile, 25 Rue du Consulat, lequel nous a déclaré
qu'il ne comprenait rien de ce qui était arrivé à son
camarade FRANCESCHI.

Mr.TERNI ne pense pas que ce soit lui qui
était visé à la place de Mr.FRANCESCHI car il sort
chaque soir, rentre fort tard dans la nuit, parfois
même à trois heures du matin et n'a jamais rien remar-
qué d'anormal autour de lui.

Mr.TERNI a ajouté qu'il n'avait jamais rien
eu avec des chinois et qu'il ne s'était jamais occupé
d'affaire louche.

Le Garde Tonkinois N°149 qui était de service
devant la Chancellerie, a déclaré qu'il n'avait pas vu
de taxi en station à l'endroit indiqué par Mr.FRANCESCHI
surtout dans le sens dont ce Monsieur le prétend.

L'agent chinois 133 a déclaré que vers 17 h.30
il avait remarqué un taxi en station devant le Consulat
de France, que ce taxi était en panne et que peu après
le véhicule a été remarqué dans un garage. Cette der-
nière remarque a été reconnue exacte.

Une enquête faite par le détective 225 dans
les garages "Ford" "Johnson" "Silver" "Taylor"
"Édouard" "Kia" et "Tong Sing" est restée sans résultat.

Nous notons que Mr.FRANCESCHI n'a aucune res-
semblance avec Mr.TERNI.

Mr.le Sous-Directeur, Chef de la Sûreté, a
également entendu Mr.FRANCESCHI.
Ci-joint déclaration.
l'Inspecteur.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

23时，我们在其住所领事馆路25号接触了特里尼先生，他向我们表示，他不明白他的同事弗朗切斯基发生了什么事。

特里尼先生不认为是自己代替弗朗切斯基先生成为了目标，因为他每晚都外出，深夜很晚才回来，有时甚至到凌晨三点，且从未注意到周围有任何异常。

特里尼先生还补充说，他从未与中国人有过任何纠葛，也从未涉足可疑事务。

在公署门前执勤的东京籍巡捕第149号声明，他没有看到有出租车停在弗朗切斯基先生所指的位置，特别是按照该先生所称的方向停放。

华捕第133号声明，约17时30分，他注意到一辆出租车停在法国领事馆前，该出租车发生故障，不久后该车辆出现在一家车库中。后一观察结果被确认为准确。

侦探第225号在“福特（Ford）”、“约翰逊（Johnson）”、“西尔弗（Silver）”、“泰勒（Taylor）”、“爱德华（Édouard）”、“起亚（Kia）”和“同兴（Tong Sing）”车库进行的调查未获结果。

我们注意到，弗朗切斯基先生与特里尼先生毫无相似之处。

警务处副处长兼保安科长也听取了弗朗切斯基先生的陈述。
附声明书。
督察。
